tips.title: Glove Set Height vs Belt Line · Cutter (FC 89mph) vs Changeup/Sinker (CH/SI)
tips.cue: Glove resting low on belt buckle vs high at chest letters
tips.timestamp_window: Second Mark: 0:02.4 · Window: -0.85s Set Position Pause (Video Frames -36 to -20)
tips.delivery_phase: Stationary Set Position (-1.20s to -0.65s before hand break)
tips.target_body_part: Glove Set Anchor Height relative to Belt Line
tips.what_to_spot: On the cutter (FC 89mph), Rodriguez sets his hands 2.4 inches lower against his belt buckle during the stationary pause; on changeups (CH 84mph) and four-seamers (FF), he sets higher across the mid-chest letters.
tips.direction: On the cutter (FC 89mph), Rodriguez sets his hands 2.4 inches lower against his belt buckle during the stationary pause; on changeups (CH 84mph) and four-seamers (FF), he sets higher across the mid-chest letters.
tips.lookFor: On the cutter (FC 89mph), Rodriguez sets his hands 2.4 inches lower against his belt buckle during the stationary pause; on changeups (CH 84mph) and four-seamers (FF), he sets higher across the mid-chest letters (5.4× separation floor).
tips.what_to_look_at: Glove set anchor position relative to belt line during pre-pitch sign check.
tips.fires_vs_random: Low belt set indicates 87.5% cutter execution (vs 23.5% baseline).
tips.scouting_note: Broadcast CF PoC: Lower glove anchor on FC clears 5.4× visibility floor with 0s temporal leakage.

tips.title: Hand Break Timing & Separation Dwell · Sinker vs Changeup
tips.cue: hand separation speed from chest
tips.timestamp_window: Second Mark: 0:01.6 · Window: -0.06s Hand Break Initiation (Video Frames -3 to 0)
tips.delivery_phase: Hand Separation & Stride Initiation (-0.10s to 0.00s at hand break)
tips.target_body_part: Hand Break Timing & Forearm Separation Angle
tips.what_to_spot: Faster, more aggressive hand separation out of the glove correlates with primary fastball/sinker sequencing, whereas changeups exhibit a slight deceleration pause at the top of the chest.
tips.direction: Faster, more aggressive hand separation out of the glove correlates with primary fastball/sinker sequencing, whereas changeups exhibit a slight deceleration pause at the top of the chest.
tips.lookFor: Faster, more aggressive hand separation out of the glove correlates with primary fastball/sinker sequencing, whereas changeups exhibit a slight deceleration pause at the top of the chest (3.8× separation floor).
tips.what_to_look_at: Acceleration of throwing hand exiting glove pocket at hand break.
tips.fires_vs_random: Fast hand break indicates 81.2% sinker/fastball execution.
tips.scouting_note: Rhythmic variance provides early trigger for hitters committing to fastball velocity.

tips.title: Glove Webbing Flap Angle at Stride Plant · Changeup vs Fastball
tips.cue: glove webbing angle during front foot strike
tips.timestamp_window: Second Mark: 0:01.2 · Window: -0.04s Front Foot Plant (Video Frames -3 to 0)
tips.delivery_phase: Hand Separation & Foot Strike (-0.10s to 0.00s at hand break)
tips.target_body_part: Glove-Side Webbing Tuck vs Open Face
tips.what_to_spot: On Changeups, Rodriguez tucks the glove webbing firmly against his left ribcage at foot strike; on hard fastballs, the mitt stays slightly open facing third base.
tips.direction: On Changeups, Rodriguez tucks the glove webbing firmly against his left ribcage at foot strike.
tips.lookFor: On Changeups, Rodriguez tucks the glove webbing firmly against his left ribcage at foot strike (4.1× separation floor).
tips.what_to_look_at: Glove webbing position relative to ribcage as front foot touches down.
tips.fires_vs_random: Tucked glove indicates 82.8% changeup execution.
tips.scouting_note: Tuck mechanic stabilizes upper body rotation on offspeed.

tips.title: Wrist Depth Inside Glove Collar · Slider (SL) vs Sinker (SI)
tips.cue: wrist tucked deep into pocket on slider
tips.timestamp_window: Second Mark: 0:02.1 · Window: -0.45s Pre-Lift Glove Check (Video Frames -16 to -10)
tips.delivery_phase: Leg Lift Initiation & Glove Check (-0.55s to -0.35s before hand break)
tips.target_body_part: Throwing Wrist Depth at Glove Collar
tips.what_to_spot: Rodriguez pushes throwing wrist 1.4 inches deeper into the mitt when getting onto the slider seam vs exposed wrist on sinker.
tips.direction: Rodriguez pushes throwing wrist deeper into mitt on slider.
tips.lookFor: Rodriguez pushes throwing wrist deeper into mitt on slider (3.7× separation floor).
tips.what_to_look_at: Visibility of wrist band at glove collar during sign check.
tips.fires_vs_random: Deep wrist burial indicates 81.0% slider execution.
tips.scouting_note: Grip adjustment cue for breaking ball.

tips.title: Lead Knee Lift Peak Elevation · Sinker (SI) Downhill Plane
tips.cue: higher knee lift on sinker drive
tips.timestamp_window: Second Mark: 0:01.5 · Window: -0.22s Knee Apex Peak (Video Frames -9 to -5)
tips.delivery_phase: Peak Leg Lift Apex & Balance Point (-0.30s to -0.15s before hand break)
tips.what_to_spot: Lead right knee reaches 0.045 torso lengths higher at balance point on sinkers to drive downhill extension.
tips.direction: Lead knee lifts higher at apex on sinkers vs compact lift on changeup.
tips.lookFor: Lead knee lifts higher at apex on sinkers vs compact lift on changeup (3.4× separation floor).
tips.what_to_look_at: Kneecap height relative to belt line at top of leg lift.
tips.fires_vs_random: High knee apex yields 79.5% sinker selection.
tips.scouting_note: Kinematic tell for downhill sinker drive.
